name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM)
provider: Government of West Bengal — Higher Education Department
summary: West Bengal's flagship merit-cum-means scholarship supporting students from Class XI up to postgraduate, diploma and technical courses in state institutions.

benefit.details: Direct benefit transfer credited annually; amount depends on level and stream (₹1,000–₹5,000 per month).

deadline.label: SVMCM renewal closes 31 Dec 2026; fresh window not yet announced

special_conditions: Must be enrolled in a regular course in an institution recognised by a WB board/university authority
Only one scholarship of this kind may be held at a time

documents: Madhyamik admit card / last qualifying exam marksheet
Institution verification form signed by the head of institution

steps: Register on svmcm.wb.gov.in with a valid mobile number
Fill academic and personal details and choose your course
Upload marksheet, income certificate and bank details
Submit and note the generated applicant ID
Complete institute verification (hoi approval) within the window

notes: PORTAL CHANGE: SVMCM's own portal is svmcm.wbhed.gov.in (Higher Education Department), not the svmcm.wb.gov.in previously recorded. SVMCM applications are ALSO taken on the Aikyashree NSP-WB portal at nspwb.wbmdfc.org, so there are two valid entry points and they have different windows. The 31 December 2026 date applies to RENEWAL applications; the fresh-application deadline was not announced at the time of this review, and the 2025–26 window was reopened for SVMCM fresh and renewal 'until further notice'. Marked pending_review because a renewal-only date is not a usable deadline for a first-year student.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa — K2 (One-Time Grant)
provider: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
summary: One-time grant of ₹25,000 for unmarried girls aged 18–19 continuing education or vocational training — designed to delay early marriage and keep girls in school.

benefit.details: Credited directly to the girl's bank account on verification of enrolment and age.

special_conditions: Applicant must be unmarried and between 18 and 19 years of age when applying
Must be enrolled in an educational institution or institute of vocational/technical training
Income criterion may be relaxed for girls with disability and orphans
Applicant must be UNMARRIED — marriage disqualifies
Family income up to ₹1,20,000 per year

steps: Collect or download the K2 application form
Get institution attestation of enrolment and age
Submit through the institution or Kanyashree portal
Track sanction status using the application number

notes: Was recorded as 'rolling'. Applications are accepted throughout the academic year but CLOSE on 31 December 2026, and late submissions are not accepted — so 'rolling' understated a real deadline. K1 is ₹1,000/year for unmarried girls aged 13–18 in Class 8–12; K2 is a ₹25,000 one-time grant for unmarried women aged 18+ in higher education. Family income ceiling ₹1,20,000. Applications may be filed through the school or college as well as online. Contact support.kanyashree@wb.gov.in.

name: Aikyashree — WB Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minority Students
provider: West Bengal Minorities Development & Finance Corporation (WBMDFC)
summary: State merit-cum-means support for students of notified minority communities from Class XI to PhD, covering engineering, medical, management, law and general streams.

benefit.details: Admission + tuition fee support plus maintenance allowance; higher rates for professional courses and hostellers.

deadline.label: Aikyashree 2026–27 closes 26 Oct 2026 (extension to 15 Feb 2027 reported for some schemes)

special_conditions: Institution must be located in West Bengal (some exceptions for courses unavailable in the state)
Income limits: typically ₹1 lakh for school level and up to ₹2.5 lakh for higher study — modelled here at the higher limit

steps: Register on wbmdfcscholarship.gov.in
Select Aikyashree and fill academic details
Upload community, income and domicile proofs
Submit and complete institute verification
Track payment status on the portal

notes: PORTAL CHANGE: Aikyashree now runs on the NSP-WB portal at nspwb.wbmdfc.org, operated by the West Bengal Minorities' Development & Finance Corporation for the Minority Affairs and Madrasah Education Department. The previously recorded wbmdfcscholarship.gov.in is not the current portal; WBMDFC's own site is wbmdfc.org. The 2026–27 window opened 1 August 2026 and closes 26 October 2026 for Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, MCM and SVMCM (fresh and renewal); several college notices report an extension to 15 February 2027 for Post-Matric, TSP, MCM and SVMCM, so confirm on the portal. Income ceiling ₹2,00,000 for Pre/Post-Matric and ₹2,50,000 for MCM, with 50% minimum marks. Helpline 1800-120-2130 (toll free) or 033-4004-7468.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students (OASIS)
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
summary: Post-matric scholarship for SC/ST students of West Bengal from Class IX onwards, covering course fees and maintenance allowance through the OASIS portal.

benefit.details: Maintenance allowance plus compulsory fee reimbursement; hosteller rates are higher.

special_conditions: School level applies only from Class IX onwards
Caste certificate must be issued by a competent WB authority
ST students must generate an NSP OTR number on scholarships.gov.in before the OASIS application will be accepted

steps: Register on oasis.gov.in → Student's Corner
Verify caste certificate number online
Fill course and bank details, upload documents
Submit to Block/District verification queue
Track status until DBT credit

notes: PORTAL CHANGE: the official OASIS portal is oasis.wb.gov.in (Backward Classes Welfare Department), not the oasis.gov.in previously recorded. OASIS consolidates seven separate scholarship schemes for SC, ST and OBC students from Class 5 to PhD. Marked pending_review on the DEADLINE: the portal homepage does not publish a fixed closing date for 2026–27 and simply shows applications as open, so the 30 November date here is carried forward rather than confirmed. One source quotes 31 October 2026, another 31 March 2026. ST students must generate an NSP OTR number first. Helpline +91 84200 23311.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students (OASIS)
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
summary: Post-matric support for OBC (OBC-A / OBC-B) students of West Bengal with maintenance allowance and fee support from Class XI onwards.

benefit.details: Course-group wise maintenance allowance plus compulsory fee reimbursement.

special_conditions: Valid OBC-A or OBC-B certificate of West Bengal required
Family income cap is tighter than SC/ST (₹1 lakh) — verify current order

documents: OBC-A / OBC-B certificate (issued after cut-off year check)

steps: Register on oasis.gov.in
Verify OBC certificate number
Complete the application and upload documents
Complete block-level verification and track DBT

notes: Same OASIS portal change and same unpublished-deadline caveat as the SC/ST record.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Class IX & X, OASIS)
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
summary: Pre-matric scholarship for SC students studying in Class IX and X in West Bengal schools, easing the school-to-HS transition.

benefit.details: Day scholar and hosteller rates; includes maintenance allowance.

special_conditions: Only Class IX and X are covered under pre-matric
Parents' income certificate from competent authority required

documents: SC certificate of student or parent

steps: Register as pre-matric applicant on oasis.gov.in
Upload caste and income certificates
Get school verification
Track DBT status

notes: Same OASIS portal change. Pre-Matric SC/ST covers Class 9–10 at ₹150/month for day scholars and ₹750/month for hostellers, plus tuition reimbursement, with a ₹2,50,000 family income ceiling. Deadline unpublished on the portal, hence pending_review.

name: Nabanna Scholarship (WB Chief Minister's Relief Fund — Educational Assistance)
provider: Chief Minister's Office, Government of West Bengal
summary: One-time education assistance to deserving students of West Bengal facing acute financial hardship, disbursed from the Chief Minister's Relief Fund.

benefit.details: Sanction letter mailed on approval; amount credited to the student's bank account.

special_conditions: Very low income cap (around ₹60,000/year) — aimed at acute hardship cases
Must produce MLA/local representative recommendation in most cycles
Should not be receiving any other government scholarship

documents: Application letter to the Hon'ble Chief Minister

steps: Write the application addressed to the Chief Minister with full academic details
Attach marksheet, income proof, recommendation and bank documents
Submit at Nabanna (HRBC Building, Howrah) or upload via CMO portal
Retain the receipt number for tracking

notes: PORTAL CHANGE: Nabanna educational assistance is applied for on cmrf.wb.gov.in — the Chief Minister's Relief Fund — under the button 'Apply For Financial Assistance for Education'. The previously recorded wbcmo.gov.in is the Chief Minister's Office site, not the application portal. 'Rolling' is CORRECT here: the portal publishes no fixed last date, and once registered a student has 90 days to upload documents and submit. Eligibility is deliberately narrow — above 50% but BELOW 60% in the last examination (below 53% for PG), i.e. it targets students who miss merit scholarships — with a ₹1,20,000 family income ceiling. The award is widely reported as around ₹10,000 but the portal publishes no fixed rate chart.

name: West Bengal Freeship Scheme (Tuition Fee Waiver)
provider: Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal
summary: Tuition-fee waiver for deserving UG/PG students of West Bengal state-aided institutions whose families cannot bear course fees.

benefit.details: Full or half freeship on tuition fees, adjusted directly by the institution on recommendation.

deadline.label: Typically aligned with the academic session

special_conditions: Available only in state-aided colleges/universities of West Bengal
Recommended by the institution based on financial need and attendance
Cannot be combined with equivalent fee-waiver benefits

documents: Bank details for any refundable component

steps: Collect the freeship application form from the college office
Attach income certificate and fee receipts
Submit before the institution's internal deadline
Confirm waiver appears on the fee book/receipt

notes: No 2026–27 notification located in this review pass; the 2026-11-15 date is carried forward and unverified. Portal wbhed.gov.in (Higher Education Department) is the department site rather than a scheme-specific application page.

name: Hindi Scholarship Scheme — West Bengal
provider: Department of School Education, Government of West Bengal
summary: Encourages students of non-Hindi-speaking West Bengal to pursue higher study in Hindi-medium institutions, promoting national language learning.

benefit.details: Stipend tied to the level of study pursued in Hindi medium.

special_conditions: Course must be pursued in a Hindi-medium/recognised institution
Hindi must be one of the subjects in the qualifying exam

documents: Qualifying exam marksheet with Hindi subject

steps: Obtain the scholarship form from DI Schools (SE)
Fill and attach enrolment and marksheet proofs
Submit via the school/institution
Await district verification and sanction order

notes: No 2026–27 notification located in this review pass; the 2026-12-15 date is carried forward and unverified. school.wb.gov.in is the School Education Department portal, not a scheme page.
